workflows.name: Marketplace Platform Strategy, Business Model & Catalog Coverage

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify assortment gaps that 3P fills" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approves strategy, capex" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-514 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Platform Strategy & Seller Onboarding (PA-95.1).)
- operational: category-level 1P/3P rules and buy-box logic (W3146)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cannibalization risk**: 3P offers undercut 1P; mitigated by category-level 1P/3P rules and buy-box logic (W3146)
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/portfolio (links to VS-33); capex (links to VS-40); innovation (links to VS-30)

steps.activity: Marketplace Director/Category (links to VS-01) identify assortment gaps that 3P fills: niche/specialty, regional brands, vendor direct-ship, refurbished (links to VS-09 trade-in), long-tail SKUs; size opportunity (incremental GMV, customer acquisition, take-rate revenue)

Define business model: open marketplace vs. curated; commission % by category; fulfillment options (seller-fulfilled vs. BuildRight fulfillment / Fulfilled by BuildRight — links to VS-93); buyer protection fund; advertising integration (links to VS-48)
Steering committee approves strategy, capex (links to VS-40), 24-month P&L, and launch phasing; integrate to VS-33 strategic plan and VS-30 innovation pipeline

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Seller Operations, Legal, Finance, Quality, Brand Protection (links to VS-71)
fields.Trigger: Category gap (W3137); seller application; vendor-direct conversion (links to VS-03)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "catalog size, fulfillment capability" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Marketplace Mgr/Legal vet seller" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Quality/Brand Protection validate sample products" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-514 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Platform Strategy & Seller Onboarding (PA-95.1).)
- operational: KYB, brand-authorization check, and ongoing monitoring (W3156)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Counterfeit / unauthorized-seller risk**: Fake goods damage brand and trigger IP liability; mitigated by KYB, brand-authorization check, and ongoing monitoring (W3156)
System Touchpoints: - Seller master (links to VS-29); sanctions/KYB (links to VS-86); anti-counterfeit (links to VS-71)

steps.activity: Seller Operations recruits through: open application, vendor-direct conversion (links to VS-03), category-targeted outreach, brand outreach, distributor referrals; capture seller profile, categories, catalog size, fulfillment capability

Marketplace Mgr/Legal vet seller: business registration (SEC/DTI), tax compliance (BIR — links to VS-79), beneficial ownership & sanctions screening (links to VS-86), brand authorization/IP (links to VS-71 anti-counterfeit), product safety history (links to VS-89), references
Quality/Brand Protection validate sample products: authenticity (links to VS-71), product safety (links to VS-31/VS-89), spec match; Marketplace Mgr approves/rejects/defers with documented rationale

workflows.name: Seller Catalog Integration, Mapping & Listing Quality

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "catalog via API" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "Catalog Ops/QA enforce listing quality" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitoring for drift/changes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-514 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Platform Strategy & Seller Onboarding (PA-95.1).)
- operational: mandatory attributes and quality score; operational: attributes and quality score
Pain Points / Risks: - **Listing-pollution risk**: Poor listings damage customer experience; mitigated by mandatory attributes and quality score
System Touchpoints: - Catalog master (links to VS-01/VS-29); ecommerce search (links to VS-10); listing quality scoring

steps.activity: Seller submits catalog via API (bulk), spreadsheet, or manual portal entry; map to BuildRight product taxonomy (links to VS-01); match to existing SKU record where overlapping 1P offer (links to W3146 buy-box)

Catalog Ops/QA enforce listing quality: required attributes (title, image, spec, dimensions, hazmat flag — links to VS-24), BIR-compliant invoice description (links to VS-79), keyword SEO, image standards; reject non-compliant listings
System computes listing completeness/quality score; surfaced in search ranking (links to W3145) and seller scorecard (links to W3154); continuous monitoring for drift/changes

fields.Participants: Marketplace Director, Finance, Category (links to VS-01), Legal
fields.Trigger: Strategy (W3137); new category; seller tier change

workflows.name: Seller Pricing Rules, Commission & Fee Structure

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews for competition-law compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-514 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Platform Strategy & Seller Onboarding (PA-95.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Take-rate mis-pricing risk**: Too high repels sellers; too low loses margin; mitigated by benchmarking and tiered fees
System Touchpoints: - Commission/fee engine; pricing master (links to VS-01); competition-law review (links to VS-129)

steps.activity: Marketplace Director/Finance define commission % by category (e.g., 8–15%), referral fee, fixed fee per listing, optional Fulfilled-by-BuildRight fee (links to VS-93), advertising/promotion fee (links to VS-48), and refund/return fee allocation
Finance model break-even take-rate vs. competitive benchmarks (Lazada/Shopee — links to VS-65); set seller-tier benefits (volume rebate, premium support, faster payout — links to W3143)

Marketplace Mgr configures rules in platform: commission engine, fee schedule, pricing-parity rules (vs. external marketplaces), MAP/price-floor enforcement where contractually agreed (links to VS-01); Legal reviews for competition-law compliance

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Seller Operations, Enablement/Training, IT

- System auto-capture of "center, ticket system, performance dashboard, payout/settlement view…" (replaces manual Step 2).

Seller Operations provide tiered support: Tier 1 (self-service + email/chat), Tier 2 (account manager for mid-tier), Tier 3 (strategic account — W3143); track seller satisfaction and resolution SLA

Quarterly Business Review with strategic sellers: performance, category trends, BuildRight initiatives, seller feedback; drive joint growth plan and resolve issues

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Legal, Finance, IT, Seller Operations, CS (links to VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Seller request; performance termination (links to W3156); seller bankruptcy; contract expiry

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents offboarding rationale" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records for warranty/returns" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-514 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Platform Strategy & Seller Onboarding (PA-95.1).)
- operational: Fulfill-by-BuildRight backstop and buyer-protection fund (W3158)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stranded-order risk**: Offboarding seller strands open orders; mitigated by Fulfill-by-BuildRight backstop and buyer-protection fund (W3158)
System Touchpoints: - Seller master status (links to VS-29); payout/settlement (links to VS-15/VS-18); refunds (links to VS-80); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Marketplace Mgr documents offboarding rationale (voluntary exit, performance, policy violation, bankruptcy); for performance/policy, follows termination process per contract (cure period, written notice)

IT/Seller Operations execute offboarding: delist SKUs (preserve active orders for fulfillment), wind down open POs/payouts, settle final payout net of fees/returns/claims (W3153), return seller data per data-portability right (links to VS-91)

CS (links to VS-13) manage customer impact: notify buyers of any unfulfilled orders, process refunds (links to VS-80), alternative-product suggestions; preserve records for warranty/returns (links to VS-53/VS-32) and audit (links to VS-88)
